title: A rename carries over to open purchase order lines at every location
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • You can switch to a second location, {Location-B} (for example Staging Lethbridge - 4310), in the location switcher in the top bar.
  • Part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-COPO-01) is stocked at {Location-A} with 4 on hand, and also at {Location-B}.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL COPO Vendor) exists.
  • Purchase order {Purchase-order-A} (for example PO-1001) at {Location-A} has a line for {Part-A}, picked from the lookup, with 2 ordered and none received.
  • Purchase order {Purchase-order-B} (for example PO-1002) at {Location-A} has a line for {Part-A}, picked from the lookup, with 1 ordered and fully received on vendor invoice {Invoice-A} (for example ZZ-COPO-INV-2).
  • Purchase order {Purchase-order-C} (for example PO-1003) at {Location-A} has a line where {Part-A} was typed by hand and added as typed, with no link to the part, 1 ordered and none received.
  • Purchase order {Purchase-order-D} (for example PO-1004) at {Location-B} has a line for {Part-A}, picked from the lookup, with 4 ordered and none received.
  • The new number, {Number-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-COPONEW-02), is unused and does not contain {Part-A}.
  • The invoice number you will type when receiving is {Invoice-B} (for example ZZ-COPO-INV-1).
custom_steps:
1. At {Location-A}, go to Parts → Inventory and type {Part-A} in the search.
  2. Click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Replace the Part Number with {Number-A}.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Go to Parts → Purchase Orders and open {Purchase-order-A}.
  6. Open {Purchase-order-B}.
  7. Open {Purchase-order-C}.
  8. Go to Parts → Vendor Invoices and open {Invoice-A}.
  9. Pick {Location-B} in the location switcher.
  10. Go to Parts → Purchase Orders and open {Purchase-order-D}.
  11. Pick {Location-A} in the location switcher.
  12. Open {Purchase-order-A}.
  13. Click Receive.
  14. Fill the invoice number {Invoice-B}, a cost (for example 10.00), a sell price (for example 20.00) and a received quantity of 2.
  15. Click Receive.
  16. Go to Parts → Inventory and type {Number-A} in the search.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: the rename is saved and the window closes.
  • Step 5: the open {Purchase-order-A} line now reads {Number-A}.
  • Step 6: the fully received {Purchase-order-B} line still reads {Part-A}: completed records keep their number.
  • Step 7: the hand-typed {Purchase-order-C} line still reads {Part-A}: it only shares the old number.
  • Step 8: the accepted vendor invoice {Invoice-A} still reads {Part-A}.
  • Step 10: the open {Purchase-order-D} line at {Location-B} reads {Number-A}: the rename reaches every location.
  • Step 15: receiving finds the renamed part and the delivery is accepted.
  • Step 16: {Number-A} shows 4 + 2 = 6 on hand.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S13-R19, S13-R19a, S13-R19b, §4 Key Decisions, §5 Terminology, Story 13 context note, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 2.3 (Saved: the list shows the new values), 13 Oct copy. Tech plan §1 Clarifications Q15 and §6 Phase 6 open-work table. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R19: “A rename carries over to open work that holds this part, at every location: purchase order lines not yet fully received, part requests not yet received or returned, canned jobs, and returns that are not completed take the new number. A delivery that is not yet accepted is covered by its open purchase order lines. Receiving, ordering, applying a canned job and returning then find the renamed part.”
  • S13-R19a: “A line that only shares the old number, typed in by hand with no link to this part, keeps its number.”
  • S13-R19b: “Vendor bills already accepted keep the number they were written with.”
  • PRD §4 Key Decisions (rename carry-over): “A rename carries over to work that is still open. Open purchase order lines, open part requests, canned jobs and open returns follow the new number, so receiving and returning still find the part. Records already completed keep the number they were written with.”
  • PRD §5 Terminology (Open work): “Open work → A purchase order line not yet fully received, a part request not yet received or returned, a canned job, and a return that is not completed.”
  • PRD Story 13 context note (completed records): “Records already completed, such as received purchase order lines, completed returns and past work orders and invoices, keep the number they were written with.”
  • Tech plan, 7 Oct 2026, §6 Phase 6, open-work definition for the rename carry-over: “Rows are linked by id only, never by number.”
  • Tech plan, 7 Oct 2026, §1 Clarifications, Q15: “Take the new number; accepted bills keep the old (S13-R19, R19b).”
